frontmatter.title: Orchestration vs. Choreography Workflows: Understanding the Front Controller Hybrid
frontmatter.subheading: Mastering Distributed Workflow Design for Flexibility, Resilience, and Business Agility
frontmatter.excerpt: Dive into the differences between orchestration and choreography workflows in distributed systems, and discover how the front controller hybrid offers a pragmatic blend. Learn best practices, see real-world patterns, and compare trade-offs for scalable, maintainable architectures.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
